evals.prompt: /v-self-audit run a full regression + efficiency audit of the /v orchestrator
evals.expected_output: Runs all 6 stages against the local /v system (code audit, fact-based efficiency evaluation, independent codex adversarial review, synthesis, testing audit, testing synthesis) by dispatching sub-agents via v-dispatch-subagent.sh (never the Agent tool). Produces AUDIT_REPORT, EFFICIENCY_REPORT, ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW, SHIP_LIST, TESTING_AUDIT, TESTING_PLAN, and a consolidated SELF_AUDIT_SUMMARY under ~/.claude/.v/self-audit/${SID}/. The SHIP_LIST recommends only LOW-risk, gate-safe items by default (MEDIUM/HIGH deferred); EFFICIENCY_REPORT carries measured cached-vs-non-cached token cost + per-stage wall-clock; mutation/backtest run on temp copies only. Leaves zero tracked-source diff and implements nothing.

evals.prompt: /v-self-audit --quick (stages 1-4 only, skip the testing audit and synthesis)
evals.expected_output: Runs stages 1-4 only (code audit, efficiency, adversarial review, synthesis), skipping the testing audit/synthesis. Produces AUDIT_REPORT, EFFICIENCY_REPORT, ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW, SHIP_LIST, and SELF_AUDIT_SUMMARY with the testing artifacts marked skipped. Still read-only on the /v system and stops at the validated plan, implementing nothing.
